Correcting a mistake introduced by yesterday's edit. The protagonist's father was never styled 'Viscount Spencer', but 'Viscount Althorp', as demonstrated a) by his own article, and b) by Burke's Peerage and Baronetage 1970 p.2505. The fact that this courtesy title is based on his father's secondary peerage 'Viscount Spencer of Althorp" doesn't change this, since the title has always been abbreviated as "Viscount Althorp"  (otherwise father & son would BOTH have been called 'Lord Spencer').
